baselines.notes: Conventional R² reference = constant-mean (predict mean(actual_eval) for all — R²=0 by construction). Task 51 Phase 3 adds TWO deployable prediction baselines: (1) zero-return (predict 0 — measures whether forecasting beats a no-trade strategy), (2) training-only mean (per-sample, predict the mean of matured training targets for this horizon — pooled market-wide across all stocks; uses filter_by_target_maturity to exclude the sample's own target). A negative model R² vs constant-mean means the model did worse than the eval-set mean; compare against zero-return + training-only-mean baselines for actual deployable-skill assessment.

task54_maturity_purge.boundary_rule: validation outcomes whose 21d target maturity > earliest final-test decision date are purged

win_rate_weighted_ensemble_methodology.description: Task 51 Phase 2: split samples into first half (VALIDATION) + second half (FINAL_TEST). Compute win rates on VALIDATION only → freeze weights → apply to FINAL_TEST. VALIDATION-period WIN_RATE_WEIGHTED entries are marked 'unavailable — validation period (weights being calibrated)'. FINAL_CONSENSUS on validation: 2+ of {MAJORITY, PROBABILITY, TIER} agree (skip WIN_RATE_WEIGHTED). FINAL_CONSENSUS on final-test: 2+ of {MAJORITY, PROBABILITY, TIER, WIN_RATE_WEIGHTED} agree. Task 54 Phase 4: validation outcomes whose 21d target matures AFTER the earliest final-test decision date are PURGED from the weight calibration (their outcomes were not knowable in real time at the final-test boundary). Weights are computed at finalization only — never from partial or complete final-test results, and never inside a chunk.

sample_maturity_metadata_summary.verification: For each sample, latest_target_maturity_date <= sample_date (no target-maturity leak)

run.promotion_rule: only a FULLY-complete run whose candidate passes validation replaces walk_forward_latest.json; partial runs never touch it

limitations: Universe mode = pilot25: 25 stock(s) evaluated (ANL, BOP, BYCO, CNERGY, ENGRO, FCCL, HASCOL, HUBC, HUMNL, KEL, LOTCHEM, LUCK, MEBL, MLCF, OGDC, PAEL, PIBTL, PPL, PRL, PSO, SYS, TELE, TRG, UNITY, WTL). canonical8 (if eligible as of cutoff) + top 17 by PRE-CUTOFF total volume (liquidity proxy), >= 250 bars as of the selection cutoff — evaluation-period volume excluded. Candidate universe = 742 stocks; excluded 201 for insufficient history. NOT a fully production-validated benchmark.

Task 54 Phase 1: the universe was selected POINT-IN-TIME — eligibility + liquidity ranking use only records on or before the selection cutoff (2023-04-13), which is strictly before every evaluation decision date. Evaluation-period volume/returns did NOT influence the selection.

5 classical models evaluated (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, Random Forest, Ridge Regression). The other ~60 registered models are NOT evaluated here — see scripts/walk_forward_backtesting.py MODEL_NAMES.
Per-sample retraining on data[date < sample.date] (expanding window). No data leakage.
Task 51 Phase 1: filter_by_target_maturity ensures training rows' target endpoint (T+h) <= sample's prediction date P. Per-horizon, per-stock, pooled across stocks.

R² can be negative — that's honest (model did not outperform the constant-mean baseline on this test). Compare against zero-return + training-only-mean baselines for actual deployable-skill assessment.

Directional accuracy = fraction of samples where sign(predicted) == sign(actual). A value >50% is NOT proven predictive skill without considering sample size, baseline, serial dependence, and uncertainty.

OVERLAPPING FORECAST WINDOWS: samples are 50 trading days apart per stock, but the 21-day return windows at adjacent samples OVERLAP by 11 sessions. Outcomes are NOT independent — uncertainty estimates must use date-blocked resampling (NOT naive standard errors).
Total unique (stock, decision-date) samples = 400; total model fits = 6000 (up to 5 models × 3 horizons per sample). Do NOT describe 400 as 'samples per stock'.

Trading metrics are GROSS directional-return proxies (signed forward 21-day return, NO commission/slippage/CGT/position-sizing). Net trading P&L is unavailable. See src/lib/latent/investment-simulator.ts for the genuine trade simulator used in the Tracker.

Task 54 Phase 4: WIN_RATE_WEIGHTED uses frozen validation-period weights with a MATURITY PURGE (validation outcomes maturing after the earliest final-test decision date are excluded). Weights are computed only at finalization — never inside a chunk, never from final-test results.
Task 54 Phase 5: this report was recomputed from the raw per-sample records in the run directory — never by averaging chunk-level metrics. A partial run never publishes a report.

Training-only-mean baseline pools matured training targets across all stocks (market-wide mean). Per-stock means are NOT computed because most stocks have insufficient historical observations per horizon for a stable per-stock mean.

ml_integrity.target_construction: per-stock groupby(symbol).shift(-h) via add_forward_returns; no .fillna(0); immature rows left NaN
ml_integrity.target_maturity_filter: Task 51 Phase 1: filter_by_target_maturity excludes training rows whose target endpoint (T+h) > prediction date P. Per-horizon, per-stock, pooled. Distinct from drop_immature_targets (which only removes rows whose target VALUE is NaN).
ml_integrity.test_partition: date-based chronological_split test partition (NOT global row split=int(len*0.8)) — all rows on a given test date belong to the test partition
ml_integrity.per_sample_training: per-sample train_data = df[df['date']<sample['date']] (strict chronological, no look-ahead) + filter_by_target_maturity(hz) per horizon
ml_integrity.per_horizon_drop: per-sample, per-horizon filter_by_target_maturity — preserves shorter-horizon rows whose longest-horizon target is immature or whose endpoint extends past P
ml_integrity.realized_outcomes: actual_return uses FUTURE close prices in the test partition (strictly AFTER the decision date) — no look-ahead leakage in the realized-outcome computation
ml_integrity.ensemble_weighting: Task 51 Phase 2 + Task 54 Phase 4: WIN_RATE_WEIGHTED uses frozen validation-period weights with a maturity purge vs the final-test boundary. MAJORITY_VOTE / PROBABILITY_WEIGHTED / TIER_WEIGHTED are per-sample (safe). FINAL_CONSENSUS uses dual-mode. Ensembles computed ONLY at finalization.
ml_integrity.point_in_time_universe: Task 54 Phase 1: universe eligibility + liquidity ranking use ONLY pre-cutoff records; the cutoff precedes every evaluation decision date.
ml_integrity.chunking: Task 54: chunks split evaluation SAMPLES only — every sample trains on the FULL frozen universe pooled by date + target-maturity filter. Final metrics recomputed from raw per-sample records.
ml_integrity.baselines: Task 51 Phase 3: zero-return + training-only-mean baselines added (per-horizon, pooled market-wide). Conventional constant-mean R² reference retained per-model×horizon.
ml_integrity.walk_forward_methodology: TRUE walk-forward: each test sample's models are re-fit on all data strictly before the sample's decision date AND with target-maturity filter applied per horizon. Distinct from the simplified backtest in train_all_with_backtesting.py (Pattern #10 — latest signal applied to all test rows).
